description: Update a Space — rename it, change its privacy, assignee mode, admin permissions, or feature toggles. Only the provided fields change. Returns the updated Space.

admin_can_manage.description: Set true to let admins manage this private Space (Enterprise feature).

features.description: Feature toggles object, e.g. { due_dates: { enabled: true }, time_tracking: { enabled: true } }. Omit to keep defaults.

multiple_assignees.description: Set true to allow multiple assignees per task.

name.description: New name. Omit to keep the current name.

private.description: Set true to make the Space private, false to make it public to the Workspace.

space_id.description: ID of the Space to update.

name: update_space
